_comment: Checker roster for the optional script fan-out. Copy to config/models.json (same folder) and edit that copy. Harness names must match the scripts' built-in harnesses (claude, codex, opencode). 'command' is documentation only and is never executed. 'model': a model id your CLI accepts, or null for the CLI's own default. Optional keys: 'variant' (reasoning effort), 'rates_per_m' ({input, output} list prices in USD per million tokens, used only to estimate cost when the CLI reports none), 'cost_note' (shown in the cost report). Credentials never go here: each CLI reads its own env vars or login.

harnesses.name: claude
harnesses.notes: Strong checker for pass 2. Reports its own cost, so no rates are needed. Set 'model' to pin a specific model id.

harnesses.name: codex
harnesses.notes: Reports tokens but no cost. Fill rates_per_m with your provider's current list prices to get an estimate; zero rates mean no estimate.
harnesses.cost_note: Replace with a note about your plan, e.g. whether this CLI runs on a flat-rate subscription.

harnesses.name: opencode
harnesses.notes: Cheap checker for pass 1. Set 'model' to a provider/model id configured in your opencode install.
